_about: Techniques solvers have already named, per genre, for the insight library's rediscovery check (docs/research-walkthrough-loop.md). Written from common solving guides (Nikoli's and puzzle communities'), in our words. A library entry matches one when it states the same pattern, at any wording or generality.

akari.name: Zero clue
akari.says: a 0 clue rules out a bulb on every cell beside it

akari.name: Saturated clue
akari.says: a clue with as many open neighbours as its number gets a bulb on each of them (a 4 always; a 3 on an edge; a 2 in a corner)

akari.name: Satisfied clue
akari.says: a clue that already touches its number of bulbs rules out its other neighbours

akari.name: Only light source
akari.says: a cell that can be lit from only one cell (or must hold the bulb itself) forces a bulb there

akari.name: Diagonal pair
akari.says: two clues that share open neighbours: the shared cells' count settles the cells only one clue touches (e.g. a 3 diagonal to a 1)

akari.name: Bulbs see each other
akari.says: a cell in sight of a bulb can't hold one; two cells in the same corridor can't both

akari.name: Lit cell rule
akari.says: a cell already lit needs no bulb; cells that would leave an unlit cell with no source are ruled out

slitherlink.name: Zero clue
slitherlink.says: a 0 has no line on any of its four sides

slitherlink.name: Corner 3
slitherlink.says: a 3 in a corner of the grid has lines on both outer sides

slitherlink.name: Corner 1
slitherlink.says: a 1 in a corner has no line on either outer side

slitherlink.name: Corner 2
slitherlink.says: a 2 in a corner forces lines on the outer edges of its two neighbours along the border

slitherlink.name: Adjacent 3s
slitherlink.says: two 3s side by side have lines on the side between them and on both outer sides, with no line on the extensions of the middle one

slitherlink.name: Diagonal 3s
slitherlink.says: two 3s diagonally touching have lines on the two outer corners away from each other

slitherlink.name: 3 next to 0
slitherlink.says: a 3 beside a 0 gets the three sides away from the 0, and the line bends around

slitherlink.name: Dead end
slitherlink.says: a dot with three no-line edges has no line on its fourth; a dot with one line and one way out continues that way

slitherlink.name: Line into a corner of a 1 or 3
slitherlink.says: a line arriving at a corner of a 3 forces the two far sides; arriving at a 1 rules out the two near sides

slitherlink.name: Parity / no small loops
slitherlink.says: the loop crosses any closed curve an even number of times; a line can't close off a loop that leaves other lines out

nurikabe.name: Ones are islands of one
nurikabe.says: a 1 is surrounded by wall on every side

nurikabe.name: Cell between two clues
nurikabe.says: a cell touching two different numbered islands is wall

nurikabe.name: Unreachable cell
nurikabe.says: a cell no island can reach within its size is wall

nurikabe.name: Complete island
nurikabe.says: an island that has its full size is sealed with wall all round

nurikabe.name: Only way out
nurikabe.says: an incomplete island with one open neighbour must grow there; a wall group with one exit must continue there

nurikabe.name: No 2x2 wall
nurikabe.says: a 2x2 block of three walls makes the fourth cell island

nurikabe.name: Diagonal islands
nurikabe.says: two islands touching diagonally make both shared neighbours wall

nurikabe.name: Wall connectivity
nurikabe.says: all walls must join up, so a cell whose being island would cut a wall group off is wall

skyscrapers.name: Clue 1
skyscrapers.says: a 1 sees only the tallest, so the tallest stands next to it

skyscrapers.name: Clue N
skyscrapers.says: a clue equal to the size sees every building, so the line rises 1, 2, …, N from it

skyscrapers.name: Distance from a clue
skyscrapers.says: a clue of k rules out the tallest from the first k − 1 cells, and generally height h from cell positions that would hide too many

skyscrapers.name: Clue pair on a line
skyscrapers.says: opposite clues on one line together bound where the tallest can stand (e.g. 1 and 2)

skyscrapers.name: Hidden single
skyscrapers.says: a height with only one possible cell left in its row or column goes there

skyscrapers.name: Naked single
skyscrapers.says: a cell with only one possible height left takes it

skyscrapers.name: Visibility counting
skyscrapers.says: with some heights placed, count what the clue can still see to place or rule out the rest

masyu.name: White on the edge
masyu.says: a white pearl on the border runs along the border

masyu.name: Black near the edge
masyu.says: a black pearl next to the border (or one cell in) sends a line straight away from it

masyu.name: Three whites in a row
masyu.says: three white pearls in a line all run across that line

masyu.name: Two blacks side by side
masyu.says: adjacent black pearls send their lines away from each other

masyu.name: White must turn after
masyu.says: a white pearl's line turns in at least one of the cells before or after it

masyu.name: No small loops
masyu.says: a line that would close a loop leaving other pearls out is ruled out

hidoku.name: Forced neighbour
hidoku.says: a number whose successor (or predecessor) has only one open neighbouring cell goes there

hidoku.name: Gap path
hidoku.says: two placed numbers k apart need a path of k − 1 cells between them, which pins the cells in a tight gap

hidoku.name: Endpoint cell
hidoku.says: a cell with only one open neighbour must hold the end of a chain

hidoku.name: Distance bound
hidoku.says: a cell farther (in king moves) from a placed number than their difference can't hold it

fillomino.name: Ones are alone
fillomino.says: a 1 is walled on every side

fillomino.name: Complete region
fillomino.says: a region with as many cells as its number is walled all round

fillomino.name: Only way out
fillomino.says: a region short of its size with one open neighbour grows there

fillomino.name: Same numbers can't touch
fillomino.says: two different regions with the same number can't share a side, so the edge between equal-number cells from different regions is impossible

fillomino.name: Unreachable cell
fillomino.says: a cell no given number can reach forms its own region from the sizes still possible

star-battle.name: Stars can't touch
star-battle.says: the eight cells around a star hold no star

star-battle.name: Region in a line
star-battle.says: a region confined to one row or column claims that line's stars, ruling out the rest of the line

star-battle.name: N regions in N lines
star-battle.says: N regions confined to N rows (or columns) use all their stars, ruling out other cells there

star-battle.name: 2x2 block
star-battle.says: a 2x2 block holds at most one star
